description.p: Snitchwatch is a desktop firewall GUI that asks before any application makes a new outbound network connection. It is built on top of the OpenSnitch daemon and is designed to look and feel like Little Snitch on macOS.

The GUI ships as a sandboxed Flatpak and talks to a host-side bridge over a Unix domain socket, so it needs no network permission of its own. The privileged OpenSnitch daemon stays on the host, installed via a custom image or an rpm-ostree layer.
Initial packaging preview: bluebuild image, rpm-ostree layering path, and Flatpak GUI.
